scene.location: Inside the old culvert at the first bend, looking into the maintenance chamber north of Vespergate
scene.situation: Session 1 Turn 9. After identifying the likely carver and probable ledger in Turn 8, DevilMedlar withdrew fully behind the bend and quietly asked Nyxara what she wanted to do, stating that he preferred to keep the man alive for questioning. He apologized a second time for the accidental close contact from Turn 8 and admitted that, although it was unintended, he had liked the brief contact. Nyxara accepted the apology, answered with dry amusement, and made clear that enjoying an accident does not grant permission to repeat it. She remained comfortable and mission-focused rather than offended. Nyxara agreed that taking the carver alive is the smarter objective and proposed a nonlethal capture plan: DevilMedlar speaks from cover first and orders the man to lower the crossbow, show his hands, and leave the satchel in place; Nyxara keeps her crossbow trained on his weapon side. If he fires or rushes, Nyxara attempts to disrupt his weapon/arm while DevilMedlar closes for a nonlethal Dawnclaw takedown. If he runs deeper, Nyxara tracks while DevilMedlar pursues. No roll was required because this turn was tactical consultation and relationship dialogue rather than an attempted influence check or attack. The target remains generally alerted but does not appear to know that DevilMedlar already saw his exact position. No combat has started yet.

clues.likely_carver_route: The likely carver is visually located in the maintenance chamber beyond the first bend.
clues.culvert_alarm: Known nonlethal warning alarm remains intact and armed behind DevilMedlar and Nyxara. It has not triggered.
clues.sunscale_shard: Still unidentified, unusually warm, and previously produced a brief stronger heat pulse when oriented deeper into the culvert.
clues.likely_carver_identification: One hooded adult man beyond the bend has pale shrine-stone dust in his boot tread and a stone-carving chisel at his belt, strongly linking him to the freshly carved Lantern Road mark.
clues.possible_ledger: A thick leather-bound book-sized object is visible in the likely carver's cross-body satchel; it is consistent with Nyxara's stolen ledger description but has not yet been seized or verified.
clues.target_readiness: The likely carver is behind broken masonry with a compact crossbow aimed toward the bend. He was alerted by earlier noise but does not appear to know that DevilMedlar successfully identified his exact position.
clues.nonlethal_capture_plan: Nyxara recommends verbal surrender from cover first while she covers the target's weapon side; if he attacks, she disrupts and DevilMedlar closes for a nonlethal melee takedown; if he flees, they pursue and track.
clues.turn8_art_verified: Player manually uploaded art/sesion-1-turn-8-Wet-Stone-Tunnel-Stealthy-Ambush.png; repository listing verified the exact path in Turn 9.
clues.nyxara_ledger_confirmation: Nyxara confirmed the woman she loves is the personally important name in the stolen Velvet Coil ledger. Identity and exact relationship remain undisclosed.
